current_status.historical_note: This audit was originally written as a pre-promotion review. It was later updated after approved promotion to record that EXP03 1.25 seed999 is now the official final CICIDS hierarchical model.

selection_basis.note: Seed999 has the highest validation hierarchical score (0.913383). It is also the strongest seed on the held-out test split (highest attack-family/rare macro, best routing), so validation selection and test ranking agree - the choice is not a test-cherry-pick.

exp01_summary.result: No improvement; attack-family macro-F1 0.849111 -> 0.846994 (within noise). The hard SlowHTTPTest/FTP pair did not move; capacity is not the CICIDS Head-2 lever.

exp02_summary.tradeoff: Improved Head-2/rare but worsened routing (correct-attribution -0.0038, missed-as-benign +0.0024 vs baseline). Not promoted.
exp02_summary.superseded_by: EXP03 1.25, which beats EXP02 1.5 on attack-family (+0.0113), rare (+0.0228), correct-attribution (+0.0030) and missed-as-benign (-0.0024).

exp03_screening_summary.outcome: 1.25 selected; 1.35 destabilized tiny classes (seed42 SQL-Injection precision collapsed to 0.091, F1 0.16) and did not improve the hard pair, so 1.25 advanced to 3-seed confirmation.

selected_checkpoint_seed999_vs_baseline.note: The single promoted artifact (seed999) beats baseline on ALL six headline metrics, including both routing metrics; the tiny mean-level routing dip is a seed123 effect, not present in the selected checkpoint.

weak_class_movement.note: recall 0.437 -> ~0.491 mean, stable across seeds; still the weakest large class.
Family-mean F1 dips (seed123 recall 0.805 drags it); the selected seed999 F1 0.781 is >= baseline.
precision 0.24 -> ~0.75; from fixing Infiltration->Web-BruteForce false predictions (220 -> ~19).
Frozen at exactly 17/38 in every run; too small and entangled with Bot/Infiltration to optimize; do not over-claim.
12 samples; recall fixed 8/12; precision swings on a few FPs; never optimize.

remaining_limitations: DoS-SlowHTTPTest <-> FTP-BruteForce is the dominant unresolved confusion (~14,758 pair errors, conserved across the loss-weight sweep); EXP04 diagnostic shows it is FEATURE-LIMITED in the current 77-feature space.
FTP-BruteForce family-mean F1 is slightly below baseline (0.7787 -> 0.7705), driven by seed123; the selected seed999 is at/above baseline.
Web-XSS (38) is frozen at F1 0.618; SQL-Injection (12) is high-variance - both are tiny-support and must not be over-claimed.
3-seed mean correct-attribution is 0.000765 below baseline and missed-as-benign 0.000024 above (both far inside the ~0.0056/0.0031 std and not present in the selected seed999 checkpoint).
The current 77-feature space lacks a destination-port feature - the natural SlowHTTPTest/FTP separator - which caps the achievable separation at ~0.68 balanced accuracy.

exp04_diagnostic_summary.key_finding: A trivial linear probe on the same 77 features matches/exceeds the deep model on the pair, so there is no model headroom; only 3/77 features separate the classes and destination port is absent. More model/loss runs cannot reduce the pair error - they redistribute it.
exp04_diagnostic_summary.implication: Promoting EXP03 1.25 with documented limitations is the honest choice; raising the ceiling requires a feature-engineering / new-preprocessing protocol (a separate main-control decision).

promotion_warnings: Family-level: 3-seed mean correct-attribution -0.000765 and missed-as-benign +0.000024 vs old baseline (within noise; NOT present in the selected seed999 checkpoint).
FTP-BruteForce slightly lower than baseline on the family mean.
DoS-SlowHTTPTest <-> FTP-BruteForce remains the dominant unresolved (feature-limited) confusion.
SQL-Injection (12) and Web-XSS (38) have very small test support and must not be over-claimed.
CICIDS limitations are reported honestly and must remain documented in the final report after any promotion.
no_fake_results_statement: All metrics in this audit were read directly from the existing per-seed test_metrics.json, routing summaries, per-class/rare-class CSVs and confusion matrices, or computed from them; the 3-seed means reproduce the provided aggregate exactly. No metric was fabricated, rounded-up, or cherry-picked.
no_test_tuning_statement: Checkpoint selection used validation only (val_hierarchical_score = 0.5*val_binary_macro_f1 + 0.5*val_attack_family_macro_f1); the test split was evaluated once per seed after the best-validation checkpoint and was never used to choose hyperparameters, seeds, or thresholds. Seed999 was chosen by the highest validation hierarchical score.

integrity_snapshot.note: Recorded so any future promotion can prove the baseline was backed up before replacement.
